","closed-loop systems keep a small outpost alive. let us repair them carefully.":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","one last challenge: re-establish the relay to earth.":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","welcome to ares-1. on mars, every watt, litre and delay matters.":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,"},"abdelrahman":{"junior, come in! a crater rim has shadowed part of our pretend solar array. we have less power coming in!":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","the air machines, garden and radio all need electricity. can you help choose what gets power?":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","a strong space-weather hazard can change plans. we're practicing a shelter drill-not using real moon radiation readings.":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","one last problem: the earth radio link is offline. the crew needs your help!":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,
